details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $266 million in net inflows on July 6, with BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) leading with $209 million. This marks a strong return of institutional interest after previous outflows and helped Bitcoin stabilize above $63,000, reaching a two-week high.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Strong Inflows as BTC Recovers to $63K+

details: BonkDAO has fallen victim to a cryptocurrency attack, with approximately $20 million worth of BONK tokens drained from its treasury. The attacker successfully pushed through a malicious governance proposal to gain access to the funds.
title: BonkDAO Suffers $20M Exploit via Malicious Governance Proposal

details: Ripple has officially received its full Crypto Asset Service Provider license from Luxembourg's CSSF, confirming its compliance with the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation. This marks a significant step in global regulatory adoption.
title: Ripple Secures Full MiCA License in Europe

details: The U.S. economy added only 57,000 jobs in June, significantly below forecasts, which investors interpreted as a signal for potential monetary easing. This, coupled with President Trump reiterating his support for cryptocurrencies and hinting at a U.S. Treasury-linked digital asset account, boosted overall market sentiment. Bitcoin briefly surged to $64,000.
title: Weak US Jobs Data & Trump's Crypto Support Fuel Market Rebound

details: Bitcoin has stabilized in the $63,000-$64,000 range, successfully absorbing the impact of Strategy's recent sale of 3,588 BTC (approximately $216 million). While these sales initially caused concern, some analysts suggest they reduce "tail risk" and could help Bitcoin find a durable bottom.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes After Strategy's Latest BTC Sales

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has unveiled a 3-4 year plan to rebuild Ethereum, focusing on making it a "leaner" blockchain. A key aspect of this initiative is prioritizing quantum safety, aiming to enhance the network's long-term security.
title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines 3-4 Year "Lean Ethereum" Rebuild Plan

details: The crypto market is experiencing mixed performance, with 157 out of 390 tracked tokens rising while 233 are declining, indicating ongoing volatility. However, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index has improved from "Extreme Fear" (24) to "Fear" (27), reflecting cautious optimism among investors despite the varied market activity.
title: Crypto Market Shows Mixed Performance, Fear & Greed Index Improves

details: Multi-trillion-dollar asset manager Vanguard is reportedly hiring a crypto executive. This strategic move suggests the firm aims to deepen its involvement and influence in the cryptocurrency market.
title: Vanguard Hiring Crypto Executive to Influence Market Strategy

details: Coinbase has obtained an investment services license in the UK, which will allow the exchange to expand its offerings to include derivatives and equities trading. This represents a significant regulatory approval for Coinbase in a major financial hub.
title: Coinbase Secures UK Investment Services License
